scope: Publish exact source/results bytes with bounded, reconstructible byte chunks.

summary.scope: Publish the complete original rigid counterpart, all-state audit, matched feedback and actual native replays.

complete_rigid_audit.scope: Independently audit original-control rigid histories with direct body force/moment and fresh Panda steps.
complete_rigid_audit.limitations: Rigid-body net force/moment and fresh actual old-state Panda-step residuals are reconstructed independently without importing the coupled rigid solver. Rigidity is checked against an independent finite-rotation map, and joint integration/kinematics/contact forces use actual saved states. An explicitly allowed failed prefix is not a complete history. This does not establish physical contact/space/time convergence, native load-model accuracy or verified warmed cost.

actual_native_replays.scope: Replay independently audited original-history loads through native Quadrants recovery.
actual_native_replays.limitations: This checks the actual native production solve on objective resolved nodal loads at explicit original-history times. Full-inertia and rigid-relief inputs are separate declared problems. It does not establish finite-footprint load-model accuracy, matching rigid/deformable feedback, physical spatial/contact/time convergence or a verified warmed accuracy/cost range.

limitations: The original rigid counterpart and independently solved deformable parent now both cover all330 controls/2640 states/3.3s at identical represented geometry, mass, actuation, timestep and contact law. All2640 rigid states independently pass original body/moment/actual robot/contact/CCD gates. Seven full material-frame resolved-load comparisons separate load/history feedback from deformable linear-versus-nonlinear recovery, and14 actual native nodal replays retain original numerical budgets. The23.17% snapshot869 feedback difference is conditional coarse480-tet evidence, not a converged continuum truth or history-wide tensor maximum. Sources are actual fingers/support, not continuum islands. The previously published deformable full-history parent is referenced with its immutable manifest SHA256; all actual parent input hashes are reverified rather than duplicating those artifacts here. Full physical geometry/contact/time/regularization convergence, finite-footprint load-model/island accuracy and warmed physical accuracy/cost remain open. Production Quadrants and rigid dynamics are unchanged. Files of at least50MB are preserved as exact ordered32MiB byte ranges, individually gzip-compressed, with original/part/stored SHA256 and offsets. Join decompressed ranges in index order to restore the original file exactly; no records are reduced or excluded. Runtime staging uses hard links for unchanged small originals.
